limitations: This diagnostic does not rescore answers or modify the primary denominator:16 histories including fiction10 baseline failure.
Eligibility explains idle before model invocation; it does not prove that all idle histories are complete, correct, or already consolidated.
Two histories have one already-linked chain plus another unlinked head; one history has one standalone head. The other11 idle histories have no linked current head.
No input/source budget cap or completed-job deduplication explains these14 idle outcomes; every project has at most one head per recognized identity.
The frozen recognizer is deliberately narrower than unrestricted human language. Positive reopen-to/because/for forms can remain disconnected; no repair or retry was enacted.

Source identity is attached to selected goal/summary evidence. Ambiguous mixed-task episodes and identity-bearing text omitted from those fields can reduce recall. Coverage ambiguous_heads counts only failures whose stored goal contains an ID, so it can underreport disconnected heads.
Public snapshots here use frozen candidate code on baseline copies; they are diagnostic views, not reruns of baseline processing.
